en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.
New-product communication: Supported ZUS Coffee pre-launch research, consolidating user preferences, social feedback and competitor communication into product messages and content themes.
Social content execution: Supported 50 Instagram posts through topic planning, shooting, editing, English copy, hashtags and asset organization.

Channels and content review: Supported online launches and FamilyMart retail communication with promotional assets, store information and publishing schedules. Tracked performance weekly and completed 15+ content reviews to inform subsequent content; contributed to overall account follower growth of 11k+.

University event coordination: Coordinated product presentations, trials and Q&A with universities. Prepared demonstrations, FAQs, teaching cases and course materials with product and business teams, organized on-site activities and consolidated usage feedback into 10 product improvement suggestions for subsequent university pilots.

Needs and market support: Analysed teaching, lesson preparation and self-study needs among mainland and overseas university users. Classified 100+ community feedback items to identify recurring needs and barriers, informing communication topics and event plans.

Product content: Built a WeChat content channel from scratch and delivered 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and use cases. Organized reusable assets around product value; core-feature usage increased 30% during the internship period.
Partnership coordination: Supported Southeast Asia AI education partnerships, clarifying needs and responsibilities and following up on agreement signing and handoff.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

Market event execution: Used surveys and feedback to clarify audience needs and promotional messages. Supported user-stage promotion plans, independently designed selected online acquisition activities and assisted with publicity, product introductions and on-site execution at technology events.
Data organization and AI analysis: Used AI to build a lightweight operations dashboard, track core metrics and user paths, and identify drop-off points for promotion reviews.

Content and publishing support: Created 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts covering product features, use cases and FAQs. Screened creators by audience profile and engagement, prepared promotional assets, followed launches and checked copy and visuals for consistent brand communication.

Channel promotion and optimization: Supported Xiaohongshu, WeChat, communities and technology-event promotion. Tested titles, covers and copy, using results to inform channel spending. Campaign registrations increased 50% versus the previous week, while the first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: 2027 Master of Marketing candidate with working English and experience in market activities, product communication, digital channels and performance reviews.
Market execution: user and competitor research, event publicity, product messaging, promotional materials, university campaigns and creator collaboration.
AI: assisted copy and content ideation, data organization and analysis, dashboard creation, SOPs, task checklists and reusable templates.
Data: Excel, SPSS, SQL (basic); marketing data organization, channel monitoring, A/B tests and event reviews.
Content: WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Instagram, Canva, CapCut; Figma (basic).
Teamwork: promotional materials with product and business teams, event flow and on-site Q&A; task tracking in Feishu, DingTalk and Linear.
